verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a programmatic API with official SDKs and a CLI, so it can be driven without a UI for automation. API-key authentication is documented as an alternative to interactive sign-in, though only for the MCP connection, and webhooks support async, non-polling pipelines. However, the CLI setup described authenticates in the browser, and no CI-specific guidance appears in the pack, so headless CI use is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive CLI authentication (env-var or API-key login for the CLI), explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use an SDK to search, scrape, and interact with the web without managing raw HTTP requests.
Signing in and adding an API key are two paths to the same access
Instead of polling for status, you provide an HTTPS endpoint
